profile.summary: A nonprofit professional dance company and school founded in Oakland in 1972. It creates, performs and teaches African-derived dance that reflects the history and life of the African Diaspora. It offers performances, classes, workshops, youth programs and school residencies.

sources.title: Dimensions Dance Theater Incorporated - ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer

review.notes: Oakland-based 501(c)(3) dance company and school (EIN 23-7279914, ProPublica); the legal name, address, phone, email, 1972 founding, mission and youth/school-residency programs are confirmed on dimensionsdance.org, and they fit OUSD's after-school and classroom program contracts. The summary is neutral and supported.
